about: One entry per hand-run study. Live sources (forward experiments, the discovery library, the experiment engine) are merged in by app/services/hypothesis_register.py and are not listed here.

entries.title: Dip rules on the whole market
entries.hypothesis: Forward-experiment candidates 2 (5-day drop below -8% in an uptrend) and 5 (four down closes with VIX >= 20) earn money after costs and beat SPY on every US stock, delisted ones included.
entries.data: about 8,700 US stocks 2016-2026 with delisted names (SEC filer map + Alpaca SIP daily bars by as-of date); no delisting returns
entries.result: Candidate 2: -18.8 bps a trade (t -1.88), -41.1 bps against SPY. Candidate 5: +25.6 bps (t 1.03), -36.4 bps against SPY. Each met 0 of 4 criteria.
entries.why: The earlier edge came from the hindsight 29-stock list, not from the rule.
entries.revisit_if: A dip rule with a stated reason to beat SPY, tested on delisted-inclusive data with delisting returns.

entries.title: 50-day breakout on the whole market
entries.hypothesis: Buying a 50-day closing high, with or without a market gate, earns money after costs and beats SPY.
entries.data: about 8,700 US stocks 2016-2026 with delisted names (SEC filer map + Alpaca SIP daily bars by as-of date); no delisting returns
entries.result: Best of four settings: +10.0 bps a trade (t 0.26, needed 2.50), -94.7 bps against SPY. 0 of 4 criteria.
entries.why: No setting is close; the other three are within 6 bps of the ungated rule.
entries.revisit_if: A breakout definition that is not a re-tuning of lookback or gate on the same data.

entries.title: Post-earnings drift
entries.hypothesis: Stocks that jump on an earnings release keep rising over the next 20 sessions, after costs.
entries.data: every US-listed filer of an 8-K Item 2.02 since 2016, delisted included (SEC acceptance times + Alpaca SIP bars)
entries.result: +0.76% a 20-day hold after costs (t 1.41), -0.44% against SPY. Fails all four parts of its rule.
entries.why: The +90 to +320 bps seen on today's megacaps was survivorship; with delisted stocks the drift does not beat SPY.
entries.revisit_if: Intraday reaction data (entry within minutes of the release), which this daily test cannot see.

entries.title: Opening-gap fill
entries.hypothesis: A stock that gaps down 0.3% to 3% at the open fills the gap the same day often enough to pay after costs.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: No edge even before costs; 0 of 342 library candidates proven after the family was added.
entries.why: The fill is not there gross, so no cost assumption rescues it.
entries.revisit_if: Auction or first-minute data showing a fill the daily open-to-close bar hides.

entries.title: Insider cluster buys
entries.hypothesis: Stocks that three or more insiders buy within 30 days beat a small-cap index over the next three months.
entries.data: SEC insider data sets 2006-2026 (12,262 events) priced on Alpaca history with delisted stocks
entries.result: +0.20% excess over IWM per three-month hold after costs (t 0.31); negative against SPY.
entries.why: A first pass on yfinance prices passed only because delisted stocks were missing.
entries.revisit_if: A sub-population defined in advance (for example first-time buyers) with its own pre-registration.

entries.title: Factor ETF tilt in the slow book
entries.hypothesis: Holding a quality, value, momentum, low-volatility or blended factor ETF in place of VOO raises the passive arm's Sharpe ratio after costs.
entries.data: factor ETF adjusted closes 2005-2026 (yfinance; an ETF's history includes every stock it held)
entries.result: All eight candidates fail; none raised the arm's Sharpe in any cell and seven returned less than SPY.
entries.why: Momentum beat SPY by 0.6% a year only with more volatility, so the arm's Sharpe still fell.
entries.revisit_if: A tilt that can be backtested with delisted constituents at $0, which factor ETFs were the workaround for.

entries.title: Company event filings (Form 8-K)
entries.hypothesis: Buying after one of 25 types of 8-K filing earns money after costs and beats SPY over 20 sessions.
entries.data: about 8,700 US stocks 2016-2026 with delisted names (SEC filer map + Alpaca SIP daily bars by as-of date); no delisting returns
entries.result: None of 75 signals was selected; the six largest types made +0.34% to +1.24% a trade and lost 0.58% to 1.02% against SPY. The held-out period was not opened.
entries.why: Positive raw returns were the market's own rise; nothing beat SPY in selection.
entries.revisit_if: An event type with a stated mechanism, tested on the unopened held-out period only.

entries.title: Politicians' disclosed purchases
entries.hypothesis: Stocks a House member discloses buying beat SPY over the next 60 sessions after costs.
entries.data: about 8,700 US stocks 2016-2026 with delisted names (SEC filer map + Alpaca SIP daily bars by as-of date); no delisting returns
entries.result: +2.92% a trade (t 3.39) but -0.91% against SPY (t -2.26). Fails 3 of 4 criteria.
entries.why: The purchases lean to large stocks that rose with the index; the excess is negative.
entries.revisit_if: Disclosure data with trade dates close to filing dates (the House lag is weeks).

entries.title: The app's twelve news rules
entries.hypothesis: A stock picked by one of the app's twelve news-tone rules earns money after costs and beats SPY.
entries.data: about 8,700 US stocks 2016-2026 with delisted names (SEC filer map + Alpaca SIP daily bars by as-of date); no delisting returns; Alpaca news archive from 2015
entries.result: Every rule fails with the old reader and the improved one: -0.51% to +0.22% a trade, -0.40% to -0.91% against SPY (t -4.6 to -19.8). On the 29 paper stocks none of 12 candidates cleared the discovery gate either.
entries.why: News tone known by the next open is already in the price.
entries.revisit_if: Entry within minutes of the story, which needs intraday prices and a measured reaction time.

entries.title: SPY intraday momentum (noise band)
entries.hypothesis: The published noise-band rule, long-only and unlevered, makes money on SPY in the period its paper never saw.
entries.data: Alpaca SIP 1-minute SPY bars; held out 2024-05-01 to 2026-11-11 (636 sessions)
entries.result: -6.6% over the held-out period (-2.7% a year), Sharpe -0.68, correlation with SPY 0.35. Fails all four criteria.
entries.why: It lost 0.7% at zero cost, so there is no break-even cost; the paper replicates only in its own sample.
entries.revisit_if: Nothing on this rule. A different intraday hypothesis needs its own pre-registration and execution evidence.

entries.title: 5-minute opening-range breakout on stocks in play
entries.hypothesis: A 5-minute opening-range breakout on the 20 highest relative-volume stocks, long-only with 2 cents a share of slippage, makes money and beats SPY.
entries.data: Alpaca SIP 1- and 5-minute bars; held out 2024-01-02 to 2026-11-11 (719 sessions)
entries.result: -33.9 bps a trade (t -16.45, 5,836 trades), -27.8% a year against SPY's +19.2%. Fails all three criteria.
entries.why: Entry and stop fall inside the same 1-minute bar in 57% of held-out long trades; the published result needs the favourable ordering.
entries.revisit_if: Quote and trade timestamps that settle the order of entry and stop inside the bar.

entries.title: Full-history walk-forward sweep
entries.hypothesis: Some rule, gate or hand-written strategy among 3,104 configurations survives multiple-testing correction net of 25 bps a side.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased), 24 six-month windows 2015-01 to 2026-11
entries.result: Nothing survives at 25 bps: the reality check over all trials gives p = 0.087 and names no survivor.
entries.why: Six survive at 11 bps only; six-month lookbacks anti-correlate with the next window.
entries.revisit_if: Do not re-test these rules on history: the six frozen forward experiments carry the sweep's trial count.

entries.title: Pooled price-and-volume ranker
entries.hypothesis: One pooled gradient-boosting ranker on the point-in-time S&P 500 passes the build plan's nine rules.
entries.data: point-in-time S&P 500 replay on yfinance bars (74% of past-member days have no bar)
entries.result: Fails five of nine rules: IC t 1.63 (bar 3), one-day-lag t 1.47 (bar 2), turnover 20.2x (cap 8).
entries.why: The signal is too weak and too fast to pay for its own turnover.
entries.revisit_if: New inputs beyond price and volume; the run was registered as one attempt.

entries.title: Sector-hedged reversal (pairs kill test)
entries.hypothesis: Hedging each sector-reversal trade with its sector ETF leaves a residual of at least 60 bps a trade.
entries.data: point-in-time S&P 500 replay on yfinance bars (74% of past-member days have no bar), 2015+
entries.result: +12.5 bps a trade residual (95% CI +6.3 to +18.6, t 4.0): real, but a fifth of the 60 bps required.
entries.why: Four fills cost more than the residual; the market-neutral lane is closed for good.
entries.revisit_if: A measured cost per fill well under 3 bps, or the VIX >= 25 slice pre-registered on its own.

entries.title: Sector-relative reversal
entries.hypothesis: Short-term reversal measured against the stock's sector pays after costs on the point-in-time S&P 500.
entries.data: point-in-time S&P 500 replay on yfinance bars (74% of past-member days have no bar)
entries.result: Gross +12 to +33 bps a trade against 29 to 44 bps of cost; excess over the stock's own drift -29 to -51 bps.
entries.why: The gross edge is the stock's own drift. The strategy row was created paused.
entries.revisit_if: A measured round-trip cost below the gross edge.

entries.title: IBS and RSI(2) as a funded sleeve
entries.hypothesis: IBS or RSI(2) dip buying on the four index ETFs passes the sleeve rule at 10 bps, 25 bps or the cost model.
entries.data: yfinance daily bars 2015-2026 (index ETFs); RSI(2) stock leg on the 707-name point-in-time universe
entries.result: Nothing passes at any cost. Closest: IBS at 10 bps, net Sharpe 0.67 over T-bills, 0.33 after the 50% haircut against a bar of 0.5.
entries.why: Every number is in-sample. Both rows moved to shadow: they record signals and place no orders.
entries.revisit_if: Forward experiment 6 (IBS tagged by VIX >= 20) is the only open test of this family.

entries.title: Month-end rebalancing flow
entries.hypothesis: The month-to-date gap between SPY and IEF predicts the next session's gap at month-end or quarter-end.
entries.data: yfinance SPY and IEF adjusted closes 2002-07 to 2026-11
entries.result: Both registered variants fail; no other calendar variant was tested.
entries.why: No predictive slope after HAC errors.
entries.revisit_if: Nothing: the family was registered as two variants only.

entries.title: Defensive sleeve (TSMOM and GTAA)
entries.hypothesis: A trend-following ETF sleeve improves the slow book enough to be funded.
entries.data: ETF adjusted closes (yfinance), costs of 11 and 25 bps a side
entries.result: Both frozen designs fail the rule; no sleeve is funded and the passive arm keeps all the capital.
entries.why: Design A runs as a zero-capital shadow that places no orders.

next_decision.note: or after the next SPY drawdown deeper than 20%, whichever first

entries.revisit_if: The rule is re-decided once: at 36 months or after the next SPY drawdown deeper than 20%.

entries.title: Wider exploration universe
entries.hypothesis: Liquidity terciles outside the 45-name core list trade as well as the core once wider spreads are paid.
entries.data: point-in-time S&P 500 replay on yfinance bars (74% of past-member days have no bar) (707 symbols)
entries.result: No tercile qualifies: -25 to -46 bps a trade against the core list's +7.4 bps (2015+).
entries.why: The exploration lane stays on the core list.
entries.revisit_if: Measured spreads for the outer terciles, not a proxy.

entries.title: Meta-label BUY filter
entries.hypothesis: A calibrated model that vetoes weak BUY signals raises net results out of sample.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased), yearly walk-forward folds 2014-2026; retrained on the bot's own paper trades
entries.result: Not proven. The 80% win-rate target was unreachable (166 trades, 49.4% wins, +0.04% a trade); the retrained filter helps IBS and hurts RSI(2).
entries.why: It runs in shadow and can only be enforced through the live shadow gate.
entries.revisit_if: A forward shadow record showing the vetoed trades did worse than the taken ones.

entries.title: Eight wins in ten after costs
entries.hypothesis: Some strategy or published high-hit-rate candidate wins 80% of its trades and still makes money after costs.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased), 28 variants, three windows
entries.result: No pooled strategy reaches an 80% net win rate; the best is 64% (RSI(2) pullback).
entries.why: The goal was changed on 2026-11-06 to profit after costs.
entries.revisit_if: Nothing: the target itself was dropped.

entries.title: ADX range/trend gate
entries.hypothesis: Range strategies do better buying only in a sideways market, trend strategies only in a rising trend.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: Adopted for RSI(14) and Bollinger mean reversion only. The gate makes RSI(2), IBS and the breakout rules worse.
entries.why: Adopted by a rule fixed in advance, on in-sample history.
entries.revisit_if: A forward record on the two gated rows; the gate is a row parameter and can be reverted.
entries.caveat: In-sample on a survivor list; neither row has passed a forward test.

entries.title: VIX fear gate
entries.hypothesis: A strategy does better if it buys only when the VIX is in the right range.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: Adopted for Channel Breakout only (VIX < 20). IBS and RSI(2) make more per trade when fear is high but each fails one part of the rule.
entries.why: Adopted by a rule fixed in advance, on in-sample history.
entries.revisit_if: Forward experiments 4, 5 and 6 test the opposite reading (VIX >= 20) for dip rules.
entries.caveat: In-sample on a survivor list; the whole-market breakout test later failed.

entries.title: 200-day trend filter for RSI(2) and IBS
entries.hypothesis: RSI(2) and IBS should buy only when the last close is above its 200-day average.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: On for RSI(2) (drawdown 3.7% to 1.7%, expectancy not worse); off for IBS, where it lowers expectancy.
entries.why: Decided by a rule set in advance.
entries.revisit_if: Both rows are in shadow since 2026-11-07, so the filter decides no order today.

entries.title: RSI(2) threshold and symbol scope
entries.hypothesis: RSI(2) should enter at RSI < 5 instead of < 10, and should trade single stocks as well as index ETFs.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: RSI < 10 kept; scope widened to the 29 single stocks as an exploration change. No post-2015 interval excludes zero.
entries.why: The stock leg later failed on the point-in-time universe and moved to shadow.
entries.revisit_if: See the short-horizon re-verdict.

entries.title: SPY trend gate and position caps
entries.hypothesis: No new longs while SPY is below its N-day average, or a tighter cap on open longs, improves the book.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: SPY trend gate adopted for MACD Momentum, Channel Breakout, Trend Pullback and RSI(2). No tighter position cap adopted: caps of 12, 8 and 5 lower expectancy in every window.
entries.why: Adopted by rules fixed before the run.
entries.revisit_if: A forward record on the gated rows.

entries.title: Signal ranking, caps and the stop-out cooldown
entries.hypothesis: Ranking competing signals, changing caps or not re-buying a symbol right after a stop improves the capped book.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: Adopted: no strategy re-enters a symbol until the 10th session after a stop-out. No ranking or cap change adopted.
entries.why: The real cost was re-entry after stops.
entries.revisit_if: A forward comparison of stopped symbols' next ten sessions.

entries.title: Volatility-target and quarter-Kelly sizing
entries.hypothesis: Sizing by the loss at the stop or by quarter Kelly raises the book's profit without a worse drawdown.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: No mode is adopted; every strategy stays on the fixed fraction.
entries.why: No candidate passed the rule in every window.
entries.revisit_if: A strategy with a proven positive expectancy to size.

entries.title: Regime-aware risk budget
entries.hypothesis: Weighting each strategy by its record in the current regime cell raises expectancy per unit of risk.
entries.data: yfinance adjusted daily bars for the 45 paper symbols (a current-stock list: survivorship-biased)
entries.result: Not adopted; the setting ships off.
entries.why: The regime arm did not pass in every window.
entries.revisit_if: More trades per regime cell than the history holds.

entries.title: SH hedge while the market gate is closed
entries.hypothesis: A small long in SH while the SPY gate is closed lowers drawdown without costing return.
entries.data: yfinance daily bars for the paper symbols and SH
entries.result: No hedge size is adopted.
entries.why: No size passed the rule in every window.
entries.revisit_if: Each alternative hedge is a separate experiment with its own rule fixed first.
